question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: **just as.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"just as"** is used to draw parallels between two similar actions or events. In this context, it compares the disappearing of the pin when turned away with the disappearing of the ship due to the curvature of the Earth.
